children: Eric Voorhees, the founder of crypto trading platform ShapeShift, appears to have recently made a large purchase of Ether.
On-chain analytics platform Lookonchain said on November 14 that multiple wallets linked to Voorhees bought 48,647 Ether over the past four days, spending about $97 million.
The wallets' average purchase price was $1,994 per Ether.
Lookonchain added that the wallets still hold about $78.68 million worth of stablecoins, suggesting further purchases may follow.

title: ShapeShift Founder Eric Voorhees Buys $97 Million Worth of Ether
